Layer 2 · Motive

Rent or buy, over your horizon

At gross yields of 1.4–2% in the major cities, renting is not the financially irrational choice it is often presented as. Model your own numbers before anyone models them for you.

Net worth difference at year 7 —
  • Buying: cash out over the period—
  • Buying: equity if you sell—
  • Renting: rent paid over the period—
  • Renting: deposit invested at 4%—
  • Verdict—

What this model assumes

  • 25-year amortising mortgage, no early repayment
  • Round-trip transaction cost of 8% on purchase and sale
  • Rent grows 3% a year; a 40% down payment is invested at 4% if you rent
  • No tax on the invested deposit, no maintenance, no vacancy

The assumptions are deliberately plain. Change them to match your own situation — the conclusion should be robust to the ones you are unsure about.

What a calculator cannot decide

The number is the start of the argument, not the end of it.

This tool answers one question. The framework is where that answer is tested against the other four.
